newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-TNT options trader Booth in contact.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-TNT options trader Booth in contact.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission (ASC) said on Friday that Mark Booth, the centre of its investigation into TNT Ltd options trading, has written to broker Ord Minnett to explain his transactions but had not revealed his whereabouts.

Rose Webb, an ASC lawyer, said the letter did shed some light on the actions of Booth, which investigators believe might be a fictitious name. "I would rather not disclose the contents. We are continuing our investigations," Webb told Reuters.
"We are following various avenues to try and find out who he is," she said.
